paragraphs.text: The Carthalions (kar-THAL-ee-ans ) were an important family in Dominarian history. Their storyline was created by Jeff Gomez .
House Carthalion were the rightful rulers of Corondor , but the kingdom had been usurped by Sol'Kanar long ago.

The Carthalions tended to walk a fine line between good and evil, had a strange kind of unluckiness, a sense of betrayal, or were orphaned, and had an innate sense of justice. Many Carthalions, beginning with Carth and including Jared, had the Mark of the Elder Druid , a crescent mark on their cheek marking them for a higher destiny.
Son of Carth or simply Carth, known as Carth the Lion - a man from Corondor and founder of the line.
A Carthalion who fought for Mishra in the Brothers' War .
Jason Carthalion - ward to Oriel Kjeldos and the champion of Clan Emerald of Storgard .
Jaeuhl Carthalion - a Knight of Kjeldor and Advocate of the Juniper Order .
Jasha Carthalion - daughter of Jaeuhl and Kaysa , an Elder Druid of Terisiare during the Thaw .
Adam Carthalion - He held the houses of Arathoxia together as Lord of Castle Melmereth and House Scarlet in Ephren on Corondor . He married Gwendolyn Mor, who took the name Gwendolyn Carthalion .
Jared Carthalion - Adam's son. A planeswalker , known as the Shadowmage, who battled Ravidel . After his battle, he disappeared for centuries.
Justina Carthalion - Jared's daughter with Kristina of the Woods .
Jenson Carthalion - Jared's teenaged descendant during the Mending Age . The current Elder Druid of the Juniper Order in Yavimaya .
Unpublished comics named Justina Carthalion, daughter of Jared Carthalion and Kristina of the Woods .
